_purpose: Outbound reinsurances to close and portfolio transfers at the start of a record's year, for the sensitivity src/check_outbound_transfer_sensitivity.py only. The headline keeps R as the unadjusted opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January (the author's decision of 29 September 2026); the sensitivity replaces R by the retained balance, R minus the amount transferred out, for the confirmed records below and refits the adopted model. Amounts are in millions of the report's own currency. opening_m is the gross balance at 1 January before the transfer as the filing prints it; the sensitivity refuses an entry whose opening_m is not the record's R (in the report's currency) within 2%.
_coverage: How the register was checked on 5 October 2026 (the stage-3 PC page readings). (1) A text-layer search of all 1,065 filings (970 PDFs and 95 HTML), independently of E's ritc_scan.json, for rows labelled RITC, reinsurance to close, portfolio transfer, transfer out, LPT or novation within 25 lines below an 'At 1 January' or 'Balance at 1 January' line, with an amount; the 47 filings whose first amount is negative were read on their pages; plus a label-only search of the text layers. It found 1955_2021, 4000_2021, 2015_2020 and 1910_2023 and the 6103 commutations, and recovered 4 of the 6 earlier confirmed entries (780_2020 is a narrative sentence and 2468_2022's amount is not in a table under 'At 1 January'). (2) An OCR scan of the 180 image-only PDFs (E's OCR page cache plus local Tesseract: 7,420 pages, 59 pages without ink), which found 2007_2018, 1301_2023, 1084_2018 and 2468_2018 and the 6123_2019 commutation, and (3) an OCR scan of the 353 image-only pages in 191 partly image-only PDFs. Recall of the OCR route: 16 of 16 known outbound pages found. It remains a pattern search, so the register is a lower bound, not a proof of absence. Read and set aside as not an outbound gross transfer at the start of the year: 2689/2023 (the External RITC is in the 2022 comparative), 2791/2018 and 2021-2023, 6103's other years (outside the sample), 1884/2021-2023 (inbound), 2014/2017, 2015/2021 and 2015/2022, 1209 and 1225 (members' funds), 2623/2019, 2987/2014, 5820/2015, and 2232/2020 ('Less: portfolio transfer (1,721)', 0.4% of R, immaterial, not resolved). 1492/2023 was in that list and is not any longer: on 22 October 2026 two independent readings (F1, F2) of its page 56 found that the claims-outstanding reconciliation prints a gross 'Third party RITC balance transfer 70,445' against 'Brought forward (256,035)', the split RITC of the 2018 and prior liabilities to Syndicate 2008 effective 31 December 2022 (the 31 August 2022 loss portfolio transfer before it moved only the reinsurers' share), so it is a confirmed entry. The same two readings added 2689/2022 (External RITC 101,597 on 184,618, p35). Outbound at the start of the year but outside the working sample: 1206/2019, 1861/2022, 2007/2019, 5820/2019, 1861/2021 (run-off), 6117/2023 and 6132/2021 (scope exclusions).

1492_2023.measure: gross claims outstanding, third party RITC balance transfer of the 2018 and prior liabilities (split RITC effective 31 December 2022)

1492_2023.also_read: PDF p60, note 20 'RITC': split-RITC effective 31 December 2022 of the 2018 and prior year liabilities into Enstar's Syndicate 2008, after an LPT with Syndicate 2008 on 31 August 2022.
1492_2023.note: two independent readings of 22 October 2026 (F1, F2) give the same figures. The split RITC of the 2018 and prior liabilities of the 2020 year of account to Syndicate 2008, effective 31 December 2022 (PRA approval 25 January 2023), is booked in the 2023 claims-outstanding reconciliation: 27.5% of R. The retained balance, R less the transfer, is 185.590 (GBP m); the filing prints none. The loss portfolio transfer of 31 August 2022 that preceded it was reinsurance: it raised the reinsurers' share in 2022 (43.4m of recoveries, p56) and left gross unchanged, and the reinsurers' share leaving with the RITC is (74,446). The reconciliation shows liabilities as negative balances, so the positive 70,445 reduces the liability. The record is in the primary sample and in the 672 construction. This entry replaces the set-aside of 1492/2023 that the coverage note carried on 5 October 2026.

census_resolution.decision: decision of the Claude analysis session, 26 October 2026 (the source-history census, round 9)
census_resolution.facts: both readings read note 5 (p52): 'RITC 2020 YOA commuted into Syndicate 2791 (7,172)', 12% of the opening 59,471. K7 alone dates it: the 2022 report (6103_2022 p56) says the 2020 year's reserves were 'transferred to that syndicate in the 2021 year of account on 1st January 2023'; L7 says only that it was commuted in 2023. Both readings find the concern resolved (K7: stands; L7: the retained opening base is validated against the 2022 report's cohort reserves)
census_resolution.disposition: the amount is settled by two readings; the date rests on one reading (K7), and a census fact needs two, so the entry stays named and not adjusted. If a second reading confirms the 1 January 2023 date the entry belongs under confirmed (the sensitivity would then adjust R to 52.299); flagged, not applied
